design: Fresh-seed paired simulations; each generated dataset is reused across all six diagnostic rules. Compare in-sample, five-fold cross-fitted, and oracle overlap pass/warning rates. Hidden confounding remains zero.
monte_carlo_uncertainty: Bonferroni familywise 95% intervals across 48 profile-by-rule cells; threshold summaries provide six-rule familywise intervals with overlap/nuisance profile cells weighted equally.
interpretation: Exploratory synthetic operating study only. No threshold is selected or recommended; oracle propensities are diagnostic-only and unavailable in real observational data.
prohibited_changes: Do not tune or select a threshold from the previously inspected seeds.
Do not feed oracle assignment probabilities into AIPW or cross-fitted propensity models.
Do not treat this synthetic threshold grid as a production recommendation.
